turns.content: For a right circular cone with base radius r and height h, write the volume formula.
Differentiate the volume with respect to both measured quantities and give the total differential dV.
For r = 10 cm and h = 25 cm, with |dr| ≤ 0.1 cm and |dh| ≤ 0.1 cm, calculate the two absolute-error components.
Use root-sum-square propagation as the exact worst-case maximum for these deterministic component bounds, and give the resulting volume error.
Treat the two component magnitudes as deterministic error bounds. Has any probability, independence, or correlation model been supplied?
For a deterministic worst-case first-order estimate, give the maximum absolute volume error.
